036        protected static SharedUnlockData instance;
037        
038        public static SharedUnlockData get() {
039                if (instance == null) {
040                        instance = new SharedUnlockData();
041                        instance.loadIfNeeded();
042                }
043                return instance;
044        }

156        
157        public static Map<String, String> ILLUSTRATION_KEY_LOOKUP = null;
158        
159        public void checkIfImageIsIllustrationAndMakeAware(String spriteName) {
160                if (spriteName == null) return;
161                if (ILLUSTRATION_KEY_LOOKUP == null) {
162                        ILLUSTRATION_KEY_LOOKUP = new HashMap<>();
163                        for (String key : Global.getSettings().getSpriteKeys("illustrations")) {
164                                String sprite = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("illustrations", key);
165                                ILLUSTRATION_KEY_LOOKUP.put(sprite, key);
166                        }
167                }
168                
169                String key = ILLUSTRATION_KEY_LOOKUP.get(spriteName);
170                if (key != null) {
171                        reportPlayerAwareOfIllustration(key, true);
172                }
173        }
174        
175        
176        protected boolean reportPlayerAwareOfThing(String thingId, String setId, String codexEntryId, boolean withSave) {
177                boolean wasLocked = isEntryLocked(codexEntryId);
178                if (addToSet(setId, thingId)) {
179                        if (wasLocked && !isEntryLocked(codexEntryId)) CodexIntelAdder.get().addEntry(codexEntryId);
180                        if (withSave) saveIfNeeded();
181                        return true;
182                }
183                return false;
184        }
185        
186        public boolean isEntryLocked(String entryId) {
187                CodexEntryPlugin entry = CodexDataV2.getEntry(entryId);
188                return entry != null && entry.isLocked();
189        }
190}
